description: Hand-author all repository metadata, governance, build config, GitHub automation, documentation, helper scripts, and the comprehensive README for Vidyqor. Depends on FEAT-001 (references the real logo asset vidyqor/public/images/vidyqor-logo.svg, the vidyqor package layout, and __version__). Everything must be honest and non-fabricated per context.json: all 18 modules marked Planned, only the scaffold present; CI badge points at the real workflow with a note that CI has not yet run; security contact via GitHub private vulnerability reporting + Issues/Discussions; no invented emails/metrics/asset paths.
steps: Read /home/om/Tools/Vidyqor/.agents/tasks/scaffold-plan.md and context.json FIRST; also read FEAT-001.json findings for any paths FEAT-001 recorded.

Create pyproject.toml: [project] name='vidyqor', description, requires-python='>=3.10', readme='README.md', license MIT, authors=[{name='Vidyqor Community'}], dynamic=['version'], [project.urls] Homepage/Repository/Bug Reports on https://github.com/whoami4101/Vidyqor; [build-system] requires=['flit_core >=3.4,<4'] build-backend='flit_core.buildapi'; [tool.flit.module] name='vidyqor'; [tool.ruff] line-length=110 target-version='py310' with [tool.ruff.format] indent-style='tab' quote-style='double' and [tool.ruff.lint] select=['F','E','W','I','UP','B','RUF'] with sensible ignores. Create MANIFEST.in (Frappe conventions: include package data, exclude build artifacts).

Create dotfiles: .gitignore (Frappe/Python/Node: __pycache__, *.pyc, *.egg-info, .venv, node_modules, sites/, build dirs), .editorconfig (tab indent for .py per Frappe, lf, final newline, utf-8), .gitattributes (text=auto eol=lf, linguist hints), .pre-commit-config.yaml (pre-commit-hooks: trailing-whitespace, end-of-file-fixer, check-yaml, check-json; ruff + ruff-format; prettier), .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc (JSONC with comments and a sensible rule config).

Create governance/meta Markdown: LICENSE (MIT, 'Copyright (c) 2026 Vidyqor Community'), CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md (Contributor Covenant v2.1, enforcement via GitHub reporting — no invented email), CONTRIBUTING.md (dev setup via bench get-app/install-app, ruff/prettier/pre-commit, testing note, PR flow), SECURITY.md (GitHub private vulnerability reporting + Issues/Discussions, supported versions 0.1.x foundation), SUPPORT.md (Issues + Discussions links), CHANGELOG.md (Keep a Changelog: Unreleased + v0.1.0 foundation/scaffold entry).

Create .github issue forms + config: ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml and feature_request.yml (GitHub issue FORMS schema), ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml (blank_issues_enabled: false, contact_links to docs + GitHub Discussions), PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, FUNDING.yml (fully commented template, no handles), dependabot.yml (version:2, github-actions weekly, pip weekly, NO npm).

Create .github/workflows: ci.yml (self-contained inline Frappe server test: MariaDB + Redis service containers, python setup, pip install frappe-bench, bench init, bench new-site, bench get-app/install-app vidyqor, bench run-tests --app vidyqor; permissions contents:read, timeout-minutes per job, concurrency guard), lint.yml (ruff + ruff-format --check + prettier --check + markdownlint-cli2 + YAML validation + pre-commit run --all-files; minimal permissions + timeouts), release.yml (trigger on tag push v*, validate tag vs __version__ and CHANGELOG entry, generate release notes, create GitHub release with source archive; permissions contents:write minimal, timeouts).

Create docs/ (16 markdown files; every doc states status = foundation/scaffold only, modules Planned): getting-started/{introduction,quick-start}.md; installation/{requirements,installation}.md (install via bench get-app https://github.com/whoami4101/Vidyqor then bench --site SITE_NAME install-app vidyqor); configuration/institution-setup.md; architecture/{overview,application-structure,database-design,permissions}.md; development/{development-environment,coding-standards,testing}.md; deployment/production-deployment.md; security/security-guidelines.md; modules/module-overview.md (table of all 18 modules, status Planned, short descriptions).

Create scripts/validate_scaffold.sh (chmod +x): runs python3 -m compileall vidyqor; YAML parse of all .yml/.yaml; JSON parse of .json and JSONC-tolerant parse of .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc; tomllib parse of pyproject.toml; verify every local asset path referenced in README/docs exists; explicitly SKIP Frappe tests with a printed note; end with git status (no add/commit). Create tests/README.md (root level) pointing to vidyqor/tests/ and explaining Frappe tests live inside the app.

Create README.md LAST (references the logo asset): 19 sections in the required order — header (# Vidyqor / ### Open Source Education ERP / One Platform. Every Institution.); badges with real repo URLs (shields license MIT, GitHub stars/forks/open-issues/latest-release dynamic, CI status pointing at ci.yml, Python 3.10+, Frappe Framework static) + note 'CI has not yet run on this repo'; introduction; objectives; why Vidyqor; main features; module overview; feature implementation status TABLE (all 18 Planned, only scaffold present); technology stack; Mermaid architecture diagram; installation (real repo URL); development setup; screenshots ('No screenshots yet — application UI not built'); roadmap v0.1.0..v1.0.0 (none released); contributing; security; license; acknowledgements (Frappe Framework, Contributor Covenant, community); community links (real Issues + Discussions). Reference only vidyqor/public/images/vidyqor-logo.svg for images.

Every .json parses via json.load; .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc parses after stripping JSONC comments.

dependabot.yml has github-actions + pip ecosystems and NO npm; FUNDING.yml has no uncommented handles; config.yml has blank_issues_enabled: false.
No invented emails, no fabricated metrics/CI-pass claims anywhere.
